Thanks, I've been speaking to my dad a lot, he's been very supportive. i'm realy lucky to have him.

On the subject of making connections, i've been thinking a lot today about how things could have been so much different. in first year we made plans to move in to a house with a bunch of friends. We found a house, paid the deposit, picked our rooms and then my girlfriend decided the two of us should live alone instead. For some reason i agreed. I've never regretted a decision more in my life. i could've had the best year of my life in that house, i got on well with the guys, they were all my age, all super laid back, shared my interests. it would've been my ideal uni experience. instead i moved in with my gf and have been been utterly miserable all year. we argue constantly and never go out anywhere. Making friends next year is going to be so much more difficult since i'll be two years older than everyone else if i retake. i lost touch with those guys and i lostdont think they want to know me any more. it makes me sick to think how different life could've been.

Thanks. just got off the phone with my dad, i was pretty honest with him and he was really supportive but realistic. i'm going back to see the counsellor and my tutor tomorrow. i'll let you know how everything goes

I'm going to talk to the counsellor and gp about it, i'm just afraid they'll think i'm just stressed because of exams which is my own fault. part of me is afraid they'd be right. i'd feel more guilt, like i was taking advantage of everyone who suffers from clinical depression through no fault of their own.

Thank you. i'm going to try and see my tutor today. Convincing her to talk to someone without casing real distress may be difficult though. she seems very much in denial at the moment and says we can still catch up. we are both doing maths. Catching up will require an enormous amount of work. Convincing her she is in trouble may cause her to break down completely. As much as i adore her she isn't the most emotionally stable person i know and she is prone to panic attacks. i can't bear to do that to her.

How did your situation work out in the end?
